The packet allows the L2 case to be converted only per decision D-11, and D-11 has not ruled this question: it is asked at BUILD-MAP-001.md 910, and the 2026-10-31 ruling (BUILD-MAP-001.md 950; BUILD-QUEUE-001.json R0-09 'ruling') covers business-profile editing only. So the L2 case stays an it.todo with its CONTRADICTION text and an AWAITING note, and no required case pins either answer for SUPER_ADMIN (review CR-R002-1 reverted the 108fc253 conversion). The service membership check itself is pinned without deciding the question: RR-R002-01..03 call the real markInvoicePaid, markInvoicePaymentFailed and updateInvoiceStatus with a real USER who holds no membership in A and the invoice's own tenant, the arguments the controller forwards (RA-G4-12), expect ForbiddenException 'Not authorized to update this invoice' with nothing written, and then show the owner's identical call succeeding. The contract text is not edited.

allowAdditionalCases is true for those two it.todo records only. evaluate.mjs judges a required case whose status is todo as KF_PROOF_REQUIRED_CASE_SKIPPED and, with allowAdditionalCases false, an unnamed one as KF_PROOF_UNEXPECTED_CASE, so no setting of this manifest admits a visible todo with allowAdditionalCases false. Every other assertion of the six bound suites is required by its full title: R0-02 judged a copy of this manifest with allowAdditionalCases false against the green report and the only unexpected cases were RA-G4-13, RA-G16-01 and RR-R002-04, the three todos of that head; R0-SEC3-INVOICE-WRITE-PROJECTION turned RR-R002-04 into a real case and requires it here, leaving two. Cases of the bound suites are also required by other manifests (payments-actor.json, public-payment-intent.json and pay-link-token-gate.json bind parts of the L2 file; invoice-create-contract.json and quote-status-auth.json parts of the L1 file); a rename therefore rejects those manifests as well as this one, and a packet that renames one edits each manifest that names it.

LEDGER: postingsFor() in the L2 file sees only an invoice's own postings (externalRef Invoice:<id>: or sourceId = the invoice id); a mark-paid posts with sourceType Payment, sourceId = the payment id and externalRef Payment:<paymentId>:payment_recorded, which it cannot see (review SEC-R002-2). The ledger observations are therefore: RA-G1-01 and RA-G4-06 leave business A's FinancialTransaction count unchanged (ledgerCountA; RA-G1-01's own cogs filter is structurally empty, since the copy's line has no productId and postCogsForPaidInvoice posts nothing without one), RA-G4-06 also writes no posting for the copy, RA-G1-03 writes exactly one Invoice:<copy>:invoice_finalized posting, and RR-R002-01..03 leave the count unchanged for each refused call and then show it rising on the owner's identical call (RR-R002-01 finds that call's Payment:<id>:payment_recorded posting through paymentPostingsFor, joined through the copy's payments; RR-R002-03 the REVERSAL and the AR posting). PC-07 pins the AR posting on send and the REVERSAL on void. The canary RVA_SECRET_ is asserted absent from every denied or public body.

CLOSED by R0-SEC3-INVOICE-WRITE-PROJECTION (review SEC-R002-3; R0-02 recorded it as an it.todo with 'DEFERRED: follow-up packet'). markInvoicePaid reloads the invoice with booking: true, and InvoiceWorkflowService.transition (behind payment-failed, the status route and PATCH {status}) updates with the same include, so every route answering through toInvoiceWriteResponse (commerce.controller.ts), which projected only the contact, handed a revenue:write member with no bookings scope the whole linked Booking row (notes, location, calendarEventId, staffId, orgUnitId) that the operator invoice read (OPERATOR_INVOICE_INCLUDE, no booking) does not disclose (the SEC-CMF1-2 class). toInvoiceWriteResponse now drops the booking relation on every write route; the service return, which the invoice listeners read, is unchanged. RR-R002-04 links a booking (notes, location, calendarEventId, staff member, org unit) to a copy per route and drives, as rva_staffWriteA (scope map { revenue: 'write' }, so bookings is 'none'), mark-paid, payment-failed, the status route on void and send, PATCH {status:'PAID'}, PATCH {status:'VOID'} and a PATCH edit: each answers 200 with the write landed, the SEC-CMF1-2 contact keys, no booking key and none of the booking's values, the operator read of the same copy carries none either, and the booking row stays linked.
